issues.detail: The Greek 'αι δυο ελαιαι' (the two olive trees) and 'δυο λυχνιαι' (two lamps/lampstands) are translated as 'hai cây ô-li-ve' and 'hai chân đèn'. However, the Vietnamese 'Hai người ấy' (Those two people) introduces a human subject ('người') that is not present in the Greek text. The Greek refers to the trees and lamps directly as 'these' (ουτοι).
